dedupe_keys.name: buildsyspro edf modelica library for buildings districts and energy systems

description: BuildSysPro is the Modelica library that EDF's research division uses for modelling buildings, districts and energy systems, released as open source; the repository is the official one. The current release is version 3.7.0; since version 3.6.0 the IBPSA Modelica library, developed in IBPSA Project 1 in which EDF takes part, is integrated. The library is compatible with OpenModelica 1.17.0, and the README advises careful initial conditions and the Dassl, Euler or Runge-Kutta solvers when using OpenModelica. Coverage: generic buildings and systems. Access: free on GitHub with self-training documents. Licence: BSD 3-Clause. Caveats: the EDF product page was under maintenance on 2026-09-26, and solver settings matter for convergence. Simulation uses: dynamic building thermal simulation, heat pump and HVAC control studies, and district-scale co-simulation with other Modelica libraries. Related records: the Modelica IBPSA library, the Modelica Buildings library and OpenModelica.
